'''Viidaav''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was inhabited by the [[Viidaav (species)|Viidaav species]].

==History==
{{Quote|The ''Viidaav'' colony is all but lost&mdash;as you requested.''"<br />"''Has the Republic landed most of their troops?''"<br />"''Enough to set the trap.|Grievous and Dooku|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
Viidaav was the site of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], until it was found by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology note">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume'' 5]] dates its stories, including "[[Heroes on Both Sides (comic story)|Heroes on Both Sides]]," to just before and during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Battle of Viidaav|allowed]] the Republic to land their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on Viidaav in order to spring a trap.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />
